changes.reason: Restore normal attack-role baseline damage while retaining the conditional follow-up identity; 45% linked attack remains the combo reward, not the sole source of damage.

changes.decision: recommended mild reduction, subject to final rule retest
changes.reason: A common card offers reliable healing plus low-health shield. Reduce both moderately and keep hybrid protection.

retainWithExplanation.reason: Shield providers retain substantial end-of-turn shield; one-turn HP-saved comparisons understate stored defense. Do not increase simply to match healers.
Weak generic marginal damage but strong compatible-panel gains are specialization tradeoffs; do not tune every tagged specialist to generic peers.
Disruptor damage and protection are distinct axes; a zero protection component alone is not evidence the whole card is weak.

measurementLimits.reason: CORRECTION: current skill requires edge position and shield at least 5. Standard panel starts at shield 0. The earlier full-HP assumption was obsolete and is retained as an invalid condition-coverage attempt; a new edge/shield 5 vs no-shield vs interior probe supplies current-condition evidence.
Creation happens for future appearances. Final measurement adds six-turn trajectories for summoning, beyond the 13 attackGrowth sources.
